title: GPT-6 Astra coding agent mein muft
content:
Ab tum GPT-6 Astra aur Fable 5.1 seedhe apne coding agent mein muft laga sakte ho.
Apne coding agent mein setup ka exact tareeka yeh hai.

Step 1.
Is site pe jao.
Google se login karo.
Models kholo.
GPT-Astra wahan muft pada hai.
Saath mein Fable 5.1, DeepSeek, aur Qen 3.8.

Step 2.
GPT-Astra pe click karo.
API keys pe jao.
Naya key banao.
Turant copy kar lo.
Yahi sab kholta hai.

Step 3.
Ab desktop pe apna coding agent kholo.
Mere paas Open Code hai, isliye main usi se jaata hoon.
Settings mein jao.
Custom provider add karo.
Base URL aur API key paste karo.
Model id daalo, GPT-Astra.
Submit dabao.

Ab tumhara agent sabse taakatwar model muft chala raha hai.
Aur sach mein, yeh kaam karta hai.
Maine isse poori websites banayi hain.
Aur ek hi prompt se khelne layak games bhi.
Comment karo, Astra.
Main poora setup bhej dunga.
